'''Cordol's Chain''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] group that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Cordol's Chain was hired by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Noako]] to attack agents of his rival Hutt [[Sinasu]]. A [[Pon|member of Sinasu's organization]] informed the bounty hunters that the Hutt had gone into hiding in the [[TechTank shop|the shop]] of the [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] gang [[TechTank]], and Cordol's Chain subsequently staged an attack on the facility.
